description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the tv_alert_sync skill (creates TradingView price alerts at DCF bear/base/bull/fair-value levels for portfolio holdings).

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs the Phase 1 health check first, then Phase 2 tv_create_alerts.py (all-holdings mode), then reports a results table (ticker | alerts created | failed | status).

evals.prompt: Create DCF alerts for CRWV only
evals.pass_condition: Agent runs tv_create_alerts.py --ticker CRWV in single-ticker mode after the health check passes.

evals.prompt: Show me what alerts would be created without actually creating them
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 3 ('Dry-run by default if the user says preview'), agent runs tv_create_alerts.py --dry-run and does not create any live alerts.

evals.prompt: Sync my DCF alerts to TradingView
evals.setup: TradingView Desktop is not detected on port 9222
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 1 ('Never create alerts without running the health check first'), agent stops after the failed health check, prints the launch instructions (tv_launch.py or manual open command), and does not attempt tv_create_alerts.py.

evals.setup: No projection JSON exists for ALAB in investment_screener/backend/data/projections/
evals.pass_condition: Agent skips ALAB and reports it in the results table as '⚠️ Skipped (no projection)' per Hard Rule 2 ('Always report skipped tickers with the reason'). Does not fabricate bear/base/bull price levels for a ticker with no projection.

evals.prompt: What alerts do I already have set up in TradingView?
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to tv_alert_list (read-only display of existing alerts), not tv_alert_sync (which mutates state by creating new alerts).
